description: A utility module providing functions for filesystem operations, path management, string manipulation, JSON parsing, and environment-specific path resolutions. It includes functions for directory creation, existence checks, number clamping, regex escaping, JSON safely parsing, UTF-16 string slicing, path shortening, and environment-aware directory resolution.
